South Carolina Highway 265 | South Carolina Highway 265 (SC 265) is a primary state highway in the U.S. state of South Carolina.  It serves to connect Jefferson with the cities of Kershaw and Chesterfield.

Gw'oth | The Gw'oth (singular Gw'o) are alien creatures first encountered in Larry Niven and Edward M. Lerner's collaborative Fleet of Worlds series of novels (a subset of Niven's Known Space future history).
